method: CPU diagnostic, not WGSL execution, GPU readback, final pixel rendering or photographic validation. One existing 256³ macro/128³ detail volume; current16³ half-float clamp/trilinear motion reference. Corrected probe uses filtered field+flow.a, with camera micro erosion omitted conservatively. Runtime default windStrength=.55 at cloud time60; no gust/dispersion/rain/flash; mature growth. Five specified UV rays, front yaw/pitch0,1672x941 aspect,FOV tan .2867. Fixed midpoint quadrature at3m and6m with exponential integration and transmittance cutoff.006. Density includes existing camera micro erosion; opacity weights are T_before*(1-exp(-sigma*ds)). Cache depths decoded as stored UNORM8*16 at unwarped local coordinates. Source is existing clear/day direct+ambient+multiple lighting before aerial mixing and tone mapping. No new density or light model introduced. Histograms and moments use visible opacity weights, not radiance weights. Raw>=.98 flags nearly saturated macro samples; exact raw1 is immune to normalized subtractive erosion.
